channel.translateBatch.hint: Same-slug channels missing in the target site are created the way site creation copies them (settings, body, custom fields and permissions; parent by slug, models by name). Existing ones are compared field by field: the name, SEO title/keywords/description and body are translated only while still identical to this site's (i.e. untranslated); hand-edited values are never overwritten. Slugs and custom field values stay unchanged. Names and SEO fields go in one call; bodies are translated channel by channel and written as each finishes, which can take minutes.
